findings.highlight: dragged in
findings.evidenceJa: 引き寄せられるように連れてこられた
findings.governingReading: led in as though drawn or pulled
findings.explanation: The mature variant turns an eerie manner of being led into direct physical dragging.

findings.highlight: get started
findings.evidenceJa: もう準備はできている
findings.governingReading: the preparations are already complete
findings.explanation: A statement about readiness becomes an imperative to begin.

findings.highlight: A heavy sound
findings.evidenceJa: とん、と
findings.governingReading: a light thump
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds weight to the sound of the captive being pushed into the room.

findings.highlight: throwing
findings.evidenceJa: 人影を部屋に押し込んだ音
findings.governingReading: the sound of pushing the other figure into the room
findings.explanation: The mature branch strengthens a push into a throw.

findings.highlight: pushing in the person
findings.evidenceJa: 人影を部屋に押し込んだ音
findings.governingReading: the sound of Shinji pushing the person he brought into the room
findings.explanation: Exposed variant debris produces malformed English and obscures the action.

findings.highlight: The floor of the secret room is wriggling around
findings.evidenceJa: 何物かがずるずると蠢いていた跡
findings.governingReading: tracks left by something that had wriggled over the floor
findings.explanation: A trace of prior movement becomes the floor itself moving.

findings.highlight: leech-like insects are writhing all over the floor
findings.evidenceJa: 得体の知れない魔物ども
findings.governingReading: unidentifiable monsters raised by Matou Zouken
findings.explanation: The mature branch invents visible leech-like insects actively covering the floor.

findings.highlight: These are lust worms
findings.evidenceJa: 得体の知れない魔物ども
findings.governingReading: unidentifiable monsters
findings.explanation: mirror moon supplies a specific creature name where this scene initially withholds their identity.

findings.highlight: love human blood, semen, and marrow
findings.evidenceJa: 得体の知れない魔物どもによるものだ
findings.governingReading: the tracks were made by the unknown monsters Zouken keeps
findings.explanation: The mature branch invents a three-part diet.

findings.highlight: Once swarmed by these lust worms, men
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐慎二は連れてきた何者かを部屋の中に押し込んだ
findings.governingReading: Shinji pushed the person he had brought into the room
findings.explanation: mirror moon inserts a gender-specific account of the creatures attacking men.

findings.highlight: have their spine crushed, brain sucked, and will be made into a cripple
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐慎二は連れてきた何者かを部屋の中に押し込んだ
findings.governingReading: Shinji pushed the person into the room; no victim pathology is narrated here
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents spinal destruction, brain consumption, and permanent disability.

findings.highlight: The worms will transform when attacking a woman
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐慎二は連れてきた何者かを部屋の中に押し込んだ
findings.governingReading: No transformation rule is stated
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents sex-dependent transformation behavior.

findings.highlight: violate her nerves. They will spread their tentacles all over her body and devour her spirit
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐慎二は連れてきた何者かを部屋の中に押し込んだ
findings.governingReading: No mechanism of attack is stated
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents neurological violation, tentacles, and consumption of the victim’s spirit.

findings.highlight: wet the woman’s skin with their mucus
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐慎二は連れてきた何者かを部屋の中に押し込んだ
findings.governingReading: No mucus or skin-coating action is stated
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents a mucus coating applied to female victims.

findings.highlight: excite and destroy her central nerves of pleasure
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐慎二は連れてきた何者かを部屋の中に押し込んだ
findings.governingReading: No nervous-system mechanism is stated
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents the stimulation and destruction of specialized pleasure nerves.

findings.highlight: the worms seem to love the woman’s womb
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐慎二は連れてきた何者かを部屋の中に押し込んだ
findings.governingReading: No reproductive preference is stated
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents an instinctive attraction to the womb.

findings.highlight: They do not eat female flesh, but seek the organs within them
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐慎二は連れてきた何者かを部屋の中に押し込んだ
findings.governingReading: No sex-specific feeding rule is stated
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents a distinction between avoiding female flesh and seeking internal organs.

findings.highlight: huge enough orgasms to fry her brain
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐慎二は連れてきた何者かを部屋の中に押し込んだ
findings.governingReading: No orgasmic or neurological outcome is stated
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents orgasms severe enough to destroy the victim’s brain.

findings.highlight: go into her body to devour her placenta
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐慎二は連れてきた何者かを部屋の中に押し込んだ
findings.governingReading: No entry into the body or placenta consumption is stated
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents invasion of the body and consumption of the placenta.

findings.highlight: Unwilling to eat human flesh, the worms have only one way to get what they desire
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐慎二は連れてきた何者かを部屋の中に押し込んだ
findings.governingReading: No unwillingness, desire, or exclusive feeding method is stated
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents motive and an exclusive behavioral rule for the creatures.

findings.highlight: the woman’s mind and body are completely violated and destroyed
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐慎二は連れてきた何者かを部屋の中に押し込んだ
findings.governingReading: No outcome for a female victim is narrated
findings.explanation: mirror moon inserts a categorical account of total mental and bodily destruction.

findings.highlight: The name “lust worm” must come from such characteristics
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐慎二は連れてきた何者かを部屋の中に押し込んだ
findings.governingReading: The source does not name the creatures or explain a name here
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents an etymological inference based on its own inserted exposition.

findings.highlight: Get started
findings.evidenceJa: イヤなコトは早くすまそう
findings.governingReading: Come on; let us get the unpleasant business over quickly
findings.explanation: The mature branch inserts a separate blunt command before the source-aligned coaxing.

findings.highlight: Nobody, man or woman, can survive after being thrown into a swarm of lust worms
findings.evidenceJa: 常人ではこの部屋に踏み入れた瞬間、恐怖に支配されることだろう
findings.governingReading: An ordinary person would likely be ruled by fear upon entering the room
findings.explanation: A qualified prediction about terror becomes a categorical claim of death after an invented action.

findings.highlight: The worms slither away from the person
findings.evidenceJa: 人影からナニカが離れていく
findings.governingReading: something moves away from the figure
findings.explanation: mirror moon resolves an emphasized unknown presence as visible worms.

findings.highlight: They merely reflect the light around the figure with their mucus
findings.evidenceJa: ただその周囲で、ざわざわと気配を震わせるだけである
findings.governingReading: only their presence quivers restlessly around the figure
findings.explanation: An immaterial description of unseen presences becomes visible light reflecting from invented mucus.

findings.highlight: You still have two more left
findings.evidenceJa: まだ二個、残ってるはずだろ
findings.governingReading: there should still be two remaining
findings.explanation: “Two remaining” is changed to “two more,” introducing an unstated additive reference point.

findings.highlight: The only reply comes from the worms
findings.evidenceJa: キイキイと
findings.governingReading: with a shrill kii-kii cry
findings.explanation: The creatures’ audible kii-kii response is omitted.

findings.highlight: The only reply comes from the worms
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐慎二の声に、気配が反応する
findings.governingReading: the presence reacts to Shinji’s voice
findings.explanation: The mature branch identifies the deliberately impersonal presence as worms.

findings.highlight: If you oppose me any more
findings.evidenceJa: これ以上我が侭を言っていると
findings.governingReading: if you keep being selfish or unreasonable
findings.explanation: The mature variant recasts refusal concerning the coming fight as direct opposition to Shinji.

findings.highlight: Matou Shinji threatens to reveal everything
findings.evidenceJa: お前がアイツと戦うしかなくなるぞ、と間桐慎二は宣告した
findings.governingReading: Shinji declares that the captive will have no choice but to fight him
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces the stated coercive consequence with an unsupported threat of disclosure.

findings.highlight: The person on the floor trembles
findings.evidenceJa: 押し込まれた人影の体が震える
findings.governingReading: the body of the figure pushed inside trembles
findings.explanation: mirror moon places the captive on the floor without source support.

findings.highlight: she will have to fight that person herself
findings.evidenceJa: お前がアイツと戦うしかなくなるぞ
findings.governingReading: you will have no choice but to fight him
findings.explanation: mirror moon prematurely assigns the still-concealed captive a female gender.

findings.highlight: The old man who Matou Shinji calls master
findings.evidenceJa: 師と仰ぐ老人
findings.governingReading: the old man Shinji reveres or acknowledges as his master
findings.explanation: A relationship of deference is reduced to what Shinji calls the elder.

findings.highlight: He is frantic right now. Anyone that gets in his way is his enemy
findings.evidenceJa: 今の彼は衛宮士郎への憎悪に満たされている
findings.governingReading: He is now filled with hatred for Emiya Shirou
findings.explanation: mirror moon inserts a generalized mental diagnosis and hostility toward anyone who obstructs him.

findings.highlight: forced him away from battle
findings.evidenceJa: 戦いから遠ざけた
findings.governingReading: kept him away from battle
findings.explanation: Protective distancing becomes explicit coercion.

findings.highlight: out of concern for his life
findings.evidenceJa: 彼の身を案じて
findings.governingReading: out of concern for his person or welfare
findings.explanation: Broader concern for Shinji’s well-being is narrowed to fear for his life.

findings.highlight: The worms flee to the corners of the room like an ebbing tide
findings.evidenceJa: 魔物の気配は波が引くように部屋の隅に消えていった
findings.governingReading: the presence of the monsters recedes to the room’s corners like the tide
findings.explanation: The mature branch turns a retreating supernatural presence into visible worms fleeing.

findings.highlight: the materialized woman
findings.evidenceJa: 現れた女性
findings.governingReading: the woman who appeared
findings.explanation: mirror moon specifies magical materialization where the narration only says that the woman appeared.

findings.highlight: understand how powerful the materialized woman is
findings.evidenceJa: 強大な魔と感じ恐れた
findings.governingReading: fear the appearing woman as a powerful demonic being or presence
findings.explanation: The creatures’ recognition of Rider as a powerful supernatural being is flattened into an assessment of her power.

findings.highlight: Heh. About time.
findings.evidenceJa: そうそう、あとは全部僕に任せればいいんだ
findings.governingReading: Yes, yes; just leave everything else to me
findings.explanation: mirror moon inserts an impatient, self-satisfied reaction before Shinji’s coaxing line.

findings.highlight: Long hair
findings.evidenceJa: 床に届くほどの長髪
findings.governingReading: hair long enough to reach the floor
findings.explanation: Rider’s striking floor-length hair is generalized to merely long hair.

findings.highlight: the bottom of hell
findings.evidenceJa: 密室の底
findings.governingReading: the bottom of the enclosed room
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces the concrete location with an unsupported infernal metaphor.

findings.highlight: words covered with lies
findings.evidenceJa: 誠実なまでに、嘘だけで固めた言葉
findings.governingReading: words composed entirely of lies, almost to the point of sincerity
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits the narrator’s pointed paradox that Shinji’s lie is thorough enough to resemble sincerity.
